actual_scope: P112 coordinate decoder plus one arbitrary cost-zero rectangular masked correction, followed by an arbitrary GL(2,C) basis change mixing that correction with exactly one original coordinate term.
scope_change_reason: Masked exactness and a ninth term change the all-pairs eight-term premise. The bounded family permits arbitrary zero-pairing supports and complex coefficients, but changes only one original costly term.
bottleneck_link: A cost-zero odd-entry correction creates rank-nine masked completions. Test whether mixing that correction with one original COPY can improve its complete copy-rank moment even when all additional work is optimistically free.
stop_rule: Complete the 896 affine-slice rank certificates and the quantified two-term cost argument; stop if the favorable COPY-only relaxation cannot improve the original rank-eight term. Reserve the final quarter of the 60-minute session for replay and handoff.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the scoped arbitrary-complex GL(2) obstruction. CERTIFICATE.json and independent_check.py check 896 slice spans/bases and 100352 pairings; eight exact Q(i) fixtures, nine primary and six independent rejection controls. No physical construction or new kappa.
